title: Event
description: Triggering event record — the entry point for the RCA pipeline. Captures the anomaly, alarm, or failure observation that initiates analysis.

event_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this event. Referenced by all downstream artifacts.

timestamp_end.description: Resolution or end of observation. Null if ongoing.

asset_id.description: Primary asset associated with the event. Must resolve to a KG Asset node.

component_id.description: Specific component on the asset, if known at intake. Must resolve to a KG Component node.

severity.description: Operational severity at time of reporting.

trigger_source.description: What initiated detection of this event.

actuation_type.description: Characterizes whether the event was initiated by an anomalous process condition, an expected design-basis signal (e.g., high-pressure safety injection), a suspected spurious actuation, or is unknown. When design_signal, anomaly-based FM candidates should be treated as speculative — the pipeline is verifying design-basis response, not diagnosing a failure. Defaults to unknown when not supplied by the operator.

symptom_signature.description: Structured characterization of observed symptoms — used by Step 5 to match against FMEA failure mode patterns.

anomaly_pattern.description: Telemetry pattern shape associated with this symptom, if known at intake.

affected_parameters.description: Specific measured parameters that exhibited the symptom.

related_cr_ids.description: Condition report IDs linked to this event. Must resolve to document.json records of type CR.

related_alarm_ids.description: Alarm IDs from operational_context that correspond to this event.

initial_assessment.description: Free-text initial assessment by the reporting engineer. Not AI-generated.

rca_required.description: Whether a formal RCA workflow has been initiated for this event.
